paragraphs: 24/7 Software sells operations management software that venue teams use to communicate in real time and hold down risk on event day. The buyers run stadiums, arenas, performing arts centers and other event spaces.

Staff build their own workflows, dispatch personnel and keep a detailed history of every incident record. Each record and every change to it is time and date stamped, so a response leaves an audit trail behind it. Field staff work from mobile applications for iOS and Android that let them file incident forms and close issues where they stand. The same platform schedules preventive maintenance through a computerized maintenance management system. Analytics dashboards are offered as a way to take guesswork out of guest experience and operating decisions.

Beyond ticketed sport, the company aims the software at amusement parks, zoos, aquariums, museums and fairs. College athletics departments and university facilities are named too, covering game day and wider campus operations. The company says its customer success group trains staff and supports them through onboarding.

quote.text: Command, control, dispatch—all in a single pane of glass.
